341	test('removeTrailer', (t, testDone) => {
342	  t.plan(6)
343	
344	  const fastify = Fastify()
345	
346	  fastify.get('/', function (request, reply) {
347	    reply.removeTrailer('ETag') // remove nothing
348	    reply.trailer('ETag', function (reply, payload, done) {
349	      done(null, 'custom-etag')
350	    })
351	    reply.trailer('Should-Not-Call', function (reply, payload, done) {
352	      t.assert.fail('it should not called as this trailer is removed')
353	      done(null, 'should-not-call')
354	    })
355	    reply.removeTrailer('Should-Not-Call')
356	    reply.send(undefined)
357	  })
358	
359	  fastify.inject({
360	    method: 'GET',
361	    url: '/'
362	  }, (error, res) => {
363	    t.assert.ifError(error)
364	    t.assert.strictEqual(res.statusCode, 200)
365	    t.assert.strictEqual(res.headers.trailer, 'etag')
366	    t.assert.strictEqual(res.trailers.etag, 'custom-etag')
367	    t.assert.ok(!res.trailers['should-not-call'])
368	    t.assert.ok(!res.headers['content-length'])
369	    testDone()
370	  })
371	})
372	
373	test('remove all trailers', (t, testDone) => {
374	  t.plan(6)
375	
376	  const fastify = Fastify()
377	
378	  fastify.get('/', function (request, reply) {
379	    reply.trailer('ETag', function (reply, payload, done) {
380	      t.assert.fail('it should not called as this trailer is removed')
381	      done(null, 'custom-etag')
382	    })
383	    reply.removeTrailer('ETag')
384	    reply.trailer('Should-Not-Call', function (reply, payload, done) {
385	      t.assert.fail('it should not called as this trailer is removed')
386	      done(null, 'should-not-call')
387	    })
388	    reply.removeTrailer('Should-Not-Call')
389	    reply.send('')
390	  })
391	
392	  fastify.inject({
393	    method: 'GET',
394	    url: '/'
395	  }, (error, res) => {
396	    t.assert.ifError(error)
397	    t.assert.strictEqual(res.statusCode, 200)
398	    t.assert.ok(!res.headers.trailer)
399	    t.assert.ok(!res.trailers.etag)
400	    t.assert.ok(!res.trailers['should-not-call'])
401	    t.assert.ok(!res.headers['content-length'])
402	    testDone()
403	  })
404	})
405	
406	test('hasTrailer', (t, testDone) => {
407	  t.plan(10)
408	
409	  const fastify = Fastify()
410	
411	  fastify.get('/', function (request, reply) {
412	    t.assert.strictEqual(reply.hasTrailer('ETag'), false)
413	    reply.trailer('ETag', function (reply, payload, done) {
414	      done(null, 'custom-etag')
415	    })
416	    t.assert.strictEqual(reply.hasTrailer('ETag'), true)
417	    reply.trailer('Should-Not-Call', function (reply, payload, done) {
418	      t.assert.fail('it should not called as this trailer is removed')
419	      done(null, 'should-not-call')
420	    })
421	    t.assert.strictEqual(reply.hasTrailer('Should-Not-Call'), true)
422	    reply.removeTrailer('Should-Not-Call')
423	    t.assert.strictEqual(reply.hasTrailer('Should-Not-Call'), false)
424	    reply.send(undefined)
425	  })
426	
427	  fastify.inject({
428	    method: 'GET',
429	    url: '/'
430	  }, (error, res) => {
431	    t.assert.ifError(error)
432	    t.assert.strictEqual(res.statusCode, 200)
433	    t.assert.strictEqual(res.headers.trailer, 'etag')
434	    t.assert.strictEqual(res.trailers.etag, 'custom-etag')
435	    t.assert.ok(!res.trailers['should-not-call'])
436	    t.assert.ok(!res.headers['content-length'])
437	    testDone()
438	  })
439	})

content.text:
Fixed in `lib/reply.js`, with regression tests in `test/reply-trailers.test.js`. Nothing is committed.

**`lib/reply.js:328` — `removeTrailer`** now clears the trailer state once no active callback remains:

```js
this[kReplyTrailers][key.toLowerCase()] = undefined
// when no active trailer is left, we clear the state, otherwise the
// send path still enters trailer mode and emits an empty Trailer header
for (const trailerName in this[kReplyTrailers]) {
  if (typeof this[kReplyTrailers][trailerName] === 'function') return this
}
this[kReplyTrailers] = null
```

Removing one of several trailers keeps trailer mode (the loop returns early); removing the last one makes the response behave exactly as if `trailer()` was never called — no `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, no empty `Trailer` header, and `Content-Length` is set again by the `onSendEnd` branch at `lib/reply.js:637`.

**`lib/reply.js:882` — `sendTrailer`** captures `const replyTrailers = reply[kReplyTrailers]` and uses that reference for the key list, the `typeof` guard, and the invocation. Without it, a trailer callback that removed the last remaining trailer would null the state mid-loop and the next iteration would throw a `TypeError`. The `send` branch order in `onSendEnd` is untouched — content-type detection still precedes serializer selection.

Tests: the existing `remove all trailers` case asserted the old behavior (`!res.headers['content-length']`), which is exactly what the issue describes as wrong, so I updated it to assert no `Transfer-Encoding` and `content-length: 0`, and added three cases: remove-all with a JSON payload, removal of another trailer from inside a callback, and removal of the last trailer from inside a callback.

Verification run:
- `node --test test/diagnostics-channel/*.test.js` — 15/15 pass, both before the edit (baseline, as COMPLEX.md requires for this file) and after.
- `node --test test/reply-trailers.test.js` — 19/19 pass.
- `node --test test/reply-*.test.js test/internals/reply.test.js test/stream.test.js test/hooks.test.js` — 288/288 pass.
- Not run: the full `npm test` / `borp` suite, `coverage:ci-check-coverage`, and `npx standard` lint — those commands weren't approved in this session. Every new line in `lib/reply.js` is exercised by the trailer tests above (both loop outcomes included), but I have not confirmed the repo-wide 100%-line gate.

Per the `co_change` note for this file, I checked its partner `lib/request.js`: it has no trailer handling (no `kReplyTrailers` reference), so it needed no change.
